failed_apis.why_tried: The generic GetForCurrentView guidance said to use a window-scoped factory.
failed_apis.root_cause: Those projected Microsoft.UI.Input types/factories do not exist.
failed_apis.fix: Use HWND-based COM interop for required input-pane behavior; never fabricate the projected API.

failed_apis.why_tried: The agent restored the compiling UWP calls after the fabricated replacement failed.
failed_apis.root_cause: The calls require a CoreWindow/current UWP view and are invalid in WinUI 3 desktop despite compiling.
failed_apis.fix: Remove the view-scoped entry points and implement the behavior through HWND interop.

doc_errors.correct: Use native dotnet build; winapp has no build subcommand.

doc_errors.wrong: The generic window-scoped-factory guidance omitted InputPane/CoreInputView and encouraged a nonexistent Microsoft.UI.Input replacement.
doc_errors.correct: Call out these APIs as HWND-COM-interoperability cases with no projected GetForWindowId factory.

special_apis.special_handling: Their UWP current-view accessors must not remain; feature parity requires HWND-based COM interop rather than a namespace substitution.
Resolve Include plus Link metadata, including shared path properties, and copy the physical source to the logical project path.

errors_encountered.root_cause: The scaffold and bootstrap commands were launched in parallel, so bootstrap ran before dotnet new created the target.
errors_encountered.fix: The agent waited for scaffold completion and reran bootstrap.

errors_encountered.root_cause: The skill documented a nonexistent subcommand.
errors_encountered.fix: The agent switched to dotnet build.

errors_encountered.root_cause: The agent fabricated Microsoft.UI.Input projections that are not present in Windows App SDK.
errors_encountered.fix: It reverted to Windows.UI.ViewManagement types, which compiled but remained a runtime-invalid migration.

errors_encountered.root_cause: The same nonexistent projected replacement was attempted for CoreInputView.
errors_encountered.fix: It reverted to the UWP namespace, leaving WUI0004 residue.

errors_encountered.root_cause: Reconstructed XAML used x:Bind with an unresolved local:Scenario DataType.
errors_encountered.fix: The template was changed to runtime Binding without x:DataType.

errors_encountered.root_cause: The agent assumed an unavailable interpreter while probing SDK projections.
errors_encountered.fix: It continued with installed XML metadata and repository searches.

errors_encountered.error: CS2001 missing generated .g.i.cs files and WMC9999 on the final build
errors_encountered.root_cause: The final dotnet build ran concurrently with validator's rebuild against the same obj directory.
errors_encountered.fix: The validator's own rebuild completed successfully; future builds must run sequentially.

errors_encountered.error: WUI0004 warnings for five GetForCurrentView calls
errors_encountered.root_cause: The migration validator did not treat a must-resolve adaptable pattern as residue and no analyzer was referenced during its build.
errors_encountered.fix: Re-scan mustResolve adaptable patterns independently of analyzer availability.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: The agent searched generated obj XAML and sibling SharedContent, then recreated multiple XAML files manually.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Bootstrap copied only files physically below the project directory and omitted linked csproj items.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: The agent manually located linked/generated content and authored target XAML.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Teach Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 to copy linked project items to their Link paths.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: The agent fabricated projected APIs, searched docs and installed packages repeatedly, then restored invalid UWP calls.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: The GetForCurrentView anchor omitted the InputPane/CoreInputView special case.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: It achieved a clean local build by reverting to calls that the later analyzer flagged.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Document the HWND interop requirement and make the validator reject any remaining GetForCurrentView call.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: A final build failed after the validator passed.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Validator and final dotnet build ran concurrently and raced on generated XAML output.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: The agent relied on the validator's successful internal rebuild.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: State that final build starts only after validator exits.
